scripts.watch: npm run build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ./scripts/run-vite-for-forms.js development --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ./scripts/run-vite-for-forms.js production
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ./scripts/run-vite-for-forms.js development
scripts.make-cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout certs/localhost-key.pem -out certs/localhost-cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext "subjectAltName = DNS:localhost"
